entities.name: Gaël Duval
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gaël Duval is a French entrepreneur. In July 1998, he created Mandrake Linux, a Linux distribution originally based on Red Hat Linux and KDE. He was also a co-founder of MandrakeSoft with Jacques Le Marois and Frédéric Bastok.
